verdict.rationale: Florida DOR does have a machine channel: an electronic file-and-pay program for large reemployment-tax data files, an XML schema package and batch enrollment specifications, so the sandbox axis applies. However, no evidence documents a public sandbox, test environment or certification/test submission path for exercising that channel before production. The probed application only exposes an authenticated production login shell.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
